item.title: A furniture factory caught fire, thick smoke envelops the Petaling Jaya area
item.description: PETALING JAYA: A furniture factory was destroyed in a fire at Jalan 20/1, Sea Park here today, with thick smoke enveloping the surrounding area, attracting the attention of local residents. Selangor Fire and Rescue Department (JBPM) Assistant Director of Operations Ahmad Mukhlis Mukhtar said no victims were reported to be involved in the fire. He said his department received a call at 1.22pm before machinery from the Damansara Fire and Rescue Station (BBP) arrived at the scene six minutes later.
